news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.04 (vs ₹1.21 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.04 (down from ₹1.21 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹331.0m (down 38% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹24.7m (down 71% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.5% (down from 16% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 74% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 110% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 3.0x This is considered a major risk. news.title: Spice Lounge Food Works Limited (BSE:539895) agreed to acquire Prisha Infotech Pte. Ltd for $0.15 million.
news.body:
Spice Lounge Food Works Limited (BSE:539895) agreed to acquire Prisha Infotech Pte. Ltd for $0.15 million on December 17, 2025. A cash consideration of $0.15 million will be paid by Spice Lounge Food Works Limited. Following the acquisition, Prisha Infotech Pte. Ltd would become a wholly owned subsidiary of Spice Lounge Food Works Limited.

For the period ending September 30, 2025, Prisha Infotech Pte. Ltd reported total revenue of $7.86 million.

The transaction has been approved by the board of Directors of Spice Lounge Food Works Limited. The transaction is expected to close within 12 months from execution of definitive agreement.
